HOW COACHING IS ORGANISED

Who it helps, which behaviours it builds
and how progress is tracked.

We design programmes around the everyday work of branches and commercial teams, using clear operational indicators rather than vague theory.

01 / WHO IT HELPS

Built for commercial & branch roles

Focused support for the people directly responsible for customer relationships, quotes and branch performance.

  • External sales executives and key account managers
  • Branch managers and trade counter leaders
  • Commercial directors and newly promoted technical managers
02 / BEHAVIOURS DEVELOPED

Practical habits used every week

We focus on observable habits that staff can practise in live customer conversations and weekly team reviews.

  • Structured account discovery and qualification before quoting
  • Consistent quote follow-up rather than passive chasing
  • Defending value and specification instead of defaulting to price discounts
  • Running focused weekly branch and pipeline review sessions
03 / MEASURING PROGRESS

Trackable commercial indicators

Instead of promising a fixed percentage uplift, we agree specific operational indicators your business can track over the programme.

  • Quote follow-up timeliness and reduction in overdue open quotes
  • Share of target accounts with a current decision-maker and next step
  • Quote-to-order conversion rate and gross margin discipline on proposals
  • Manager review cadence and coaching action completion

CONCRETE PROGRAMME EXAMPLE

Quote Follow-Up & Margin
Discipline Sprint.

An example of a structured coaching module for branch managers and external sales reps, combining focused sessions with real workplace application.

Discuss this programme↗
  • 1. Session focus (90-minute workshop)

    Review live anonymised quotes from the branch, identify where price concessions happened early, and agree a clear qualification and follow-up checklist.

  • 2. What participants apply at work

    Each participant logs a clear owner and follow-up date on open quotes above an agreed threshold, asks two agreed specification questions before discounting, and records the customer decision reason.

  • 3. Manager review & tracked indicators

    Two weeks later, the branch manager and coach review the reduction in overdue unfollowed quotes, the reasons recorded for won/lost quotes, and the margin band achieved across those quotes.

PUBLISHED COACHING PROGRAMMES

Six structured programmes
built for commercial growth.

Select the programme that matches your team’s priorities. Each programme can run standalone or form part of an integrated partnership.

01 / PROGRAMME

Sales Performance Sprint

Who it helps: For external sales engineers, account reps and commercial specialists facing margin compression or slow conversion.

  • Practise: Account discovery questioning, multi-stakeholder qualification and disciplined quote follow-up rhythms.
  • Takeaway: Qualification checklist, live quote negotiation playbook and weekly review cadence.
  • Review: Tracked quote follow-up timeliness, conversion on qualified quotes and reduced unearned discounts.
Discuss programme↗
02 / PROGRAMME

Branch Performance Accelerator

Who it helps: For branch managers, assistant managers and trade counter supervisors in electrical wholesale and technical distribution.

  • Practise: Weekly branch operating routines, proactive trade account phone reviews and counter trade upselling.
  • Takeaway: 90-day branch operating rhythm, trade account call schedule and branch margin discipline tracker.
  • Review: Dormant account reactivation, average order value and consistent branch gross margin maintenance.
Discuss programme↗
03 / PROGRAMME

Leadership Accelerator

Who it helps: For newly appointed general managers, regional directors and commercial leaders managing multiple sites or growing teams.

  • Practise: Commercial strategy translation, running structured 1-to-1 coaching reviews and resolving operational bottlenecks.
  • Takeaway: Executive leadership cadence framework, talent scorecard and commercial 1-to-1 meeting templates.
  • Review: Staff retention rate, quarterly leadership objective completion and cross-branch operational consistency.

04 / PROGRAMME

AI Adoption Sprint

Who it helps: For branch, sales and administrative teams adopting CRM, Communications or automated handover workflows.

  • Practise: Operating AI voice receptionists, handling owned callbacks, managing Action Queues and maintaining data hygiene.
  • Takeaway: AI workflow checklists, human-in-the-loop review standards and callback handover protocols.

05 / PROGRAMME

Intelligence-Led Growth Programme

Who it helps: For commercial directors and marketing leads seeking targeted trade account acquisition and market intelligence.

06 / PROGRAMME

Hiring Manager Academy

  • Takeaway: Interview scoring rubric, role blueprint templates and a 90-day new hire onboarding plan.
